items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: He and I was playing with Kid Clinton at the same time too.

ctx.x: Deep ass wife is from that. Yeah.
Well, yeah, you might get it. He and I was playing with Kid Clinton at the same time too. Then with Joe Robichaud, I worked a while with Joe Robichaud then he was in the band.
Was that the big band, or not the real big band, but maybe ten pieces or so that made records once with Joe, do you remember?
